title: Ab Toh Aajao Shahenshah-e-Wafa
body:
Ab Toh Aajao Shahenshah-e-Wafa x4
Ro Ro Kahti Thi Sakina Ran Mein x2
Lut Gayi Saaniye Zehra Ki Rida
Shimr Ne Maare Taamache Hai Mere Gaalon Pe
Jhirhkiyan De Ke Uthaya Hai Mujhe x2
Baba Ki Laash Pe Roney Na Diya
Cheen Kar Sab Ki Ridaen, Aur Jalaey Khaimey
Aisa Loota Hai Musalmanon Ne x2
Na Kiya Aale Mohammad Ka Haya
Tumko Abbas Ki Taaqat Pe Bharosa Tha Bohat
Qaid Hone Se Bachaye Tumko x2
Aake Yeh Shimr Ne Zainab Se Kaha
5)Taurdi Maar Ke Akbar Ke Jiggar Mai Barchi
Aur Sitamgar Ne Kaha Mola Se, Ye Suna Hai Ke Tu Saabir Hai Bara
6)Saahib ul Asr Ye Alfaaz Aata Karte Hain
Koi Khubi Ye Nahi Akhtar Ki, Iske Nohon Mai Hai Zahra Ki Dua
